method: Epoch count: leave-one-match-out on the training matches only, every fold trained for all epochs; each match's curve averaged over seeds, matches averaged equally, best epoch (earliest on ties), as train-tactics chooses the TCN's. Then each seed trained on every training clip for exactly that many epochs.

description.rows: 72 detector channels + 32 ResNet PCA numbers, as the clip-data TCN
description.transform: ResNet PCA and per-channel scaling fitted on each head's training rows only (inner training clips under nested selection), with the clip-data TCN's code
description.pooling: GRU over the rows in order, with elapsed time

note: The mean macro-F1 at the chosen epoch is optimistic: the epoch was picked on the same held-out matches. It is not a test score; no test clip was read.
